description: Child Pedestrian Safety is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Road Safety Data Hub and Analytics. This report provides a description of the circumstances of child pedestrian deaths due to motor vehicle accidents around the home and suggests some of the major factors; places these home accidents in the context of child pedestrian safety, examines the potential of available data sources for identification and understanding of low-speed vehicle run-overs beyond the home, and shows what available data sources can tell us ... Coverage is Australia, 2001 to 2010; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-07-31. Files and pages listed: PDF (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
